name: veerxcape-monorepo
description: VeerXcape Connected Vehicle Safety & Emergency-Response Platform Monorepo

scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace=@veerxcape/shared-constants && npm run build --workspace=@veerxcape/shared-types && npm run build --workspace=@veerxcape/shared-validation && npm run build --workspace=@veerxcape/shared-services
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:emulator: PATH="/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk@21/bin:$PATH" npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace=@veerxcape/functions && PATH="/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk@21/bin:$PATH" firebase emulators:exec --project veerxcape-01 --only auth,firestore,functions,storage "npm run test:emulator:unit"
scripts.emulators:start: PATH="/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk@21/bin:$PATH" npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace=@veerxcape/functions && PATH="/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk@21/bin:$PATH" firebase emulators:start --project veerxcape-01 --only auth,firestore,functions,storage
